expected_transactions.note: read_cycle: one of ctrl_hum, ctrl_meas, hum_lsb, hum_msb, press_lsb, press_msb, press_xlsb, status, temp_lsb, temp_msb, temp_xlsb

test_stimuli.name: nominal_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: bytes 0xF7-0xF9 = [0x00,0x10,0x00] -> 20-bit big-endian raw = (0x00<<12)|(0x10<<4)|(0x00>>4) = 256; pressure: bytes 0xFA-0xFC = [0x00,0x08,0x00] -> raw = (0x00<<12)|(0x08<<4)|(0x00>>4) = 128; humidity: bytes 0xFD-0xFE = [0x80,0x00] -> 16-bit big-endian raw = 0x8000 = 32768

test_stimuli.name: zero_values
test_stimuli.derivation: All raw bytes zero -> temp=0, pressure=0, humidity=0

test_stimuli.name: max_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: bytes [0xFF,0xFF,0xF0] -> 20-bit raw = (0xFF<<12)|(0xFF<<4)|(0xF0>>4) = 0xFFFFF = 1048575; pressure: same = 1048575; humidity: bytes [0xFF,0xFF] -> 16-bit raw = 0xFFFF = 65535
